Must index ~0.5M–4M historical tickets + KB, support incremental ingestion, and deliver top-5 retrieval + reranking within 200ms p95. Cost sensitivity: target <$0.005/query at current traffic; willing to pay for Dedicated for predictable latency. Security: VPC deployment, SSO, audit logs, KMS for keys, and retention controls. Must support SSO provisioning and produce an architecture diagram for infosec review.
